[{"insert":"Seated DB Press + Push Ups

This shoulder and chest giant set presses overhead first, then drops you into two push up variations back to back. Pressing first tires your shoulders out, so the push ups feel harder than usual even at just bodyweight. On the push ups you go from a wide deficit grip to a narrow grip, where the wide hands stretch the chest and the narrow hands shift the load to your triceps. Keep the rest short and push each move close to failure.
"}]
